author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The /red route carries a local copy of the reader proxy header policy instead of using the shared reader-source proxy path.
findings.consequence: Future changes to the reader proxy allowlist, redirect handling, or disconnect behavior can be applied to /txt, /bilder, and /export/faksimil while silently missing /red.
findings.evidence: Lines 21-31 define a local request-header allowlist that matches the reader proxy allowlist in server/utils/reader-source-proxy.ts, and the same shared utility already declares /red as a ReaderPrefix. Sibling routes server/routes/txt/[...path].ts and server/routes/bilder/[...path].ts are one-line wrappers around proxyReaderSourceRequest.
findings.recommendation: Move the /red-specific canonical path encoding into server/utils/reader-source-proxy.ts as an option or helper, then reduce this route to the same established wrapper shape: defineEventHandler(event => proxyReaderSourceRequest(event, "/red", { canonicalizePath: true })).
verification: Read owned unit server/routes/red/[...path].ts with line numbers.
Inspected direct imports server/utils/backend-proxy.ts, server/utils/reader-source-proxy.ts, shared/utils/text-safety.ts, and shared/utils/url-safety.ts.
Inspected sibling route callers for /txt, /bilder, and /export/faksimil.
Inspected relevant tests in test/unit/red-proxy.spec.ts and related proxy tests.
Used read-only inspection commands only; no tests were run because the review contract emphasized source inspection and the sandbox is read-only.
